Data.Description: Create, debug, and run UiPath Flow projects and jobs.

Subcommands.Name: compile
Subcommands.Description: Compile authored TypeScript to a flow artifact.

Subcommands.Name: check
Subcommands.Description: Check a source file for authoring errors before compiling it.

Subcommands.Name: decompile
Subcommands.Description: Convert a .flow artifact to authored TypeScript.

Subcommands.Name: merge
Subcommands.Description: Merge an edited flow with its original artifact.

Subcommands.Name: init
Subcommands.Description: Create a new Flow project with boilerplate files. If run outside an existing solution, a parent '<name>Solution' is scaffolded automatically and the flow project is created inside it. If run inside an existing solution, the project is added to that solution.

Subcommands.Name: pack
Subcommands.Description: Pack a Flow project into a .nupkg file

Subcommands.Name: publish
Subcommands.Description: Pack a Flow project and upload the resulting .nupkg to Orchestrator packages

Subcommands.Name: validate
Subcommands.Description: Validate a .flow file (or a project directory containing one) against the Flow schema

Subcommands.Name: debug
Subcommands.Description: Debug a flow project by uploading to Studio Web and running a debug session

Subcommands.Name: debug-instance
Subcommands.Description: Manage Flow debug instance operations

Subcommands.Name: eval
Subcommands.Description: Manage and run Flow evaluation sets

Subcommands.Name: migrate
Subcommands.Description: Migrate a .flow file to the current workflow and node schema versions

Subcommands.Name: nodes
Subcommands.Description: Manage nodes in a Flow file

Subcommands.Name: edges
Subcommands.Description: Manage edges in a Flow file

Subcommands.Name: bindings
Subcommands.Description: Manage bindings in a Flow file

Subcommands.Name: process
Subcommands.Description: Manage Flow processes

Subcommands.Name: jobs
Subcommands.Description: Manage Flow jobs

Subcommands.Name: registry
Subcommands.Description: Browse and search the maestro flow node registry to discover available activities and connectors (OOTB + authenticated). Use 'pull' to sync, 'search' to find nodes, 'get' to inspect a node's full input/output schema.

Subcommands.Name: instance
Subcommands.Description: Manage Flow process instances

Subcommands.Name: processes
Subcommands.Description: Manage Flow process summaries

Subcommands.Name: hitl
Subcommands.Description: Add HITL (Human-in-the-Loop) nodes to a Flow file

Subcommands.Name: incident
Subcommands.Description: Manage Flow incidents

Subcommands.Name: format
Subcommands.Description: Format a .flow file by auto-laying out nodes to prevent overlaps and arrange in a clean flow

Subcommands.Name: variables
Subcommands.Description: Manage variables in a Flow file

Subcommands.Name: help
Subcommands.Description: display help for command

GlobalOptions.Description: JMESPath expression applied to the Data field of the response envelope
Write logs to file instead of stderr
